blocks.description: Block definitions (DWG/DXF blocks, DGN shared cell definitions).

models.description: Model spaces, layouts and sheets that hold the drawn entities.

schema_version.description: Version of this JSON layout; see [`SchemaVersion`].

units.description: Unit of all coordinates in this document.

warnings.description: Recoverable problems met while reading. A non-empty list does not mean failure.

Attribute.description: Non-graphic data attached to an entity (DWG ATTRIB, DGN tag, item-type property).

display.description: How the value text is drawn at `position`; `None` when unknown or not drawn.

layer.description:
Layer of the attribute's own record when the format stores one (a DGN tag
element has its own level). `None` uses the owning entity's layer.

position.description: Where the attribute text is displayed, if it is displayed.

props.description: Format-specific data with no neutral field (e.g. `dgn.color_index`, `dgn.weight`).

set.description: Owning tag set / item type / definition name.

AttributeDisplay.description: Text presentation of a displayed attribute value.

halign.description: Horizontal alignment of the text about `Attribute::position`.

rotation.description: Rotation about the drawing Z axis, in radians.

style.description: Text style (DGN font) name; `None` leaves the choice to the writer's default.

valign.description: Vertical alignment of the text about `Attribute::position`.

width.description: Character width, in drawing units (DGN stores it separately from the height).

Block.description: A block definition (DGN: shared cell definition).

oneOf.description: Use the color of the inserting block reference.

AutoCAD Color Index 1..=255. DGN palette indices are resolved to [`Color::Rgb`]
by the DGN reader; the original index goes to `props["dgn.color_index"]`.

attributes.description: Attached non-graphic data: DWG attributes, DGN tags, item-type properties.

id.description: Native identifier (DWG handle, DGN element id).

layer.description: Layer name; `None` means the default layer.

raw.description: Original record bytes, kept only when [`crate::ReadOptions::keep_raw`] is set.

EntityKind.description: Geometry and type-specific data of an [`Entity`].

oneOf.description:
Connected segments, optionally with arc segments (bulge) and widths.
Covers DWG LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE and DGN line string / shape.

closed.description: Last vertex connects back to the first.

normal.description:
Plane normal; bulge arcs turn counter-clockwise about it. `+Z` for plain 2D data
and for non-planar 3D polylines (which have no bulges).

oneOf.description: A circular arc from `start_angle` counter-clockwise to `end_angle`.

end_param.description: End parameter in radians (2π for a full ellipse).

major_axis.description: Vector from the center to the end of the major axis (its length is the semi-major axis).

start_param.description: Start parameter in radians (0 for a full ellipse).

knots.description: Knot vector (may be empty when only fit points are known).

end_point.description: Baseline end for `Aligned`/`Fit` text; `None` for every other alignment.

position.description:
Anchor point implied by `halign`/`valign`: the baseline start for left/baseline
text, otherwise the justification point (DXF/DWG second alignment point, group 11).
For `Aligned`/`Fit` text: the baseline start.

oneOf.description: Multi-line, formatted text. DGN text nodes map to this when they only hold text.

plain.description: Text with format codes removed, lines separated by `\n`.

value.description: Text including format codes as stored.

oneOf.description:
A placed block (DWG INSERT, DGN shared cell instance).
Attribute values live in [`Entity::attributes`].

loops.description: Boundary loops; the first is usually the outer one.

block.description: Anonymous block holding the rendered dimension, if any.

measurement.description: Measured value in drawing units (or radians for angular).

points.description: Definition points in format order (see `props` for their roles).

filled.description: The face is filled (SOLID/TRACE) rather than a wire face.

oneOf.description:
A planar surface with optional holes, in world coordinates (WCS) and drawing units.
Each ring is explicitly closed by repeating its first point as its last point.

exterior.description: Closed outer boundary ring containing at least four positions.

interiors.description: Closed hole rings inside the exterior boundary.

arrowhead.description: Draws an arrowhead at the first vertex.

vertices.description: Vertices from arrow tip to the end.

oneOf.description: A raster image reference (DWG IMAGE, DGN raster attachment).

u_vector.description: Vector along the image bottom edge, covering the full width.

v_vector.description: Vector along the image left edge, covering the full height.

view_center.description: Model-space point shown at the center.

oneOf.description:
Entities that belong together: DGN complex chains/shapes, cells, text nodes, groups.
Children are in the same coordinate space as the group.

group_kind.description: What kind of grouping this is.

oneOf.description: A record the reader recognized but does not model; see `props` / `raw`.

type_name.description: Native type name or code, e.g. `"dgn.type_94"` or `"dwg.ACAD_TABLE"`.

oneOf.description: Not known (e.g. a document built in memory).
CityGML 2.0 (XML application schema based on GML 3.1.1).

color.description: Default color of entities on this layer.

id.description: Native identifier (DWG handle, DGN level id).

LengthUnit.description: Length unit. Mirrors the DWG `$INSUNITS` set.

oneOf.description: A unit that is not in this list; see [`Units::meters_per_unit`].

pattern.description: Dash pattern in drawing units: positive = dash, negative = gap, zero = dot.

oneOf.description: Explicit width in millimeters. DGN weight steps are converted; the original goes to props.

Model.description: A space that holds drawn entities: model space, a paper-space layout or a DGN model.

Point3.description: A 3D point. 2D data uses `z = 0` (or the elevation).

Raw.description: Original bytes of a record, for lossless inspection.

bytes.description: Record bytes exactly as stored (after decompression).

type_code.description: Native type code (DGN element type, DWG object type).

SchemaVersion.description:
Version of the [`Document`] JSON layout, serialized as the integer `schema_version`.

Every document this crate writes carries [`SchemaVersion::CURRENT`]. JSON without the
field predates versioning and reads as version 1. [`crate::export::document_from_json`]
rejects other versions with [`crate::Error::SchemaVersion`]. The version increases only
when an existing field changes meaning or shape; new optional fields do not change it.

application.description: Producing application if recorded, e.g. `"MicroStation v8.11.9.578"`.

codepage.description: Code page used for 8-bit strings, e.g. `"windows-1254"`.

version.description: Format version as written in the file, e.g. `"AC1032"`, `"V8"`, `"V7"`.

meters_per_unit.description:
Size of one drawing unit in meters, when known. Authoritative over `unit`
for non-standard DGN master units.

Value.description: A loosely typed value for attributes and props.

bulge.description: Bulge of the segment that starts here: tan(included angle / 4), 0 = straight.

end_width.description: End width of the segment that starts here.

start_width.description: Start width of the segment that starts here.

Warning.description: A recoverable problem found while reading.

object.description: Native id of the affected object, when known.

offset.description: Byte offset in the decoded stream, when meaningful.
